command_line:
set -eu
{
  printf '%s\n' '--- /software/atac-seq-pipeline ---'
  ls -la /software/atac-seq-pipeline
  printf '%s\n' '--- candidate files ---'
  find /software -maxdepth 5 -type f \( -iname '*caper*' -o -iname '*atac*' -o -name '*.wdl' \) -print 2>/dev/null | sort | sed -n '1,240p'
  printf '%s\n' '--- pipeline directory files ---'
  find /software/atac-seq-pipeline -maxdepth 2 -type f -print 2>/dev/null | sort | sed -n '1,240p'
  printf '%s\n' '--- python modules ---'
  python -m pip show caper || true
  python -m pip show atac-seq-pipeline || true
} > probe.txt
